critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Recharts console warnings about chart dimensions (-1, -1) on initial load. This is a known Recharts issue when container dimensions aren't immediately available. Not blocking functionality.
Suggestion: Consider adding error boundary around charts to gracefully handle render timing issues
